title: 第22章 真是奇耻大辱啊
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
周牧之离开之后陈默没有急着回屋，他在院子里盘腿坐下来闭上了眼睛。

    “陈默你不回屋歇着吗。”周玄站在一旁问道。

    “修炼一会儿。”

    这会儿周玄看着他盘腿坐在地上的样子心中满是担忧，他在心里想着这个陈默怎么一点都不着急。

    “陈默你刚才把周牧之给打了，他可是内门执剑长老的弟子，内门那边肯定不会善罢甘休的万一执剑长老怪罪下来怎么办。”

    “打就打了还能怎么办。”

    “可是……”

    “没什么可是，他来找我的麻烦难道我还要站着让他打不成。”

    于是他心想其实陈默说的也对，毕竟周牧之先来找麻烦的总不能让陈默站着挨打吧。

    可话虽这么说周玄心中还是放心不下，这会儿在院子里来回踱步脸上的表情写满了焦虑。

    此时周玄停下脚步叹了口气。

    于是在心里想着算了，既然陈默都不担心。

    随后他转身走进了屋里留下陈默一个人坐在院子里修炼，当阳光洒在陈默身上的时候能感觉的出来他的呼吸也是非常均匀和平稳。

    体内的真元缓缓流转，金丹五层的修为比之前更加稳固了。

    可陈默心里清楚这个实力还不够，周牧之是元婴一层的修为比他现在高出整整一个大境界还多。

    今天能击退周牧之全靠乾坤镜的突然袭击，如果正面交锋他根本不是周牧之的对手所以必须尽快提升实力才行。

    这会儿陈默在心中想着然后继续运转体内的真元。

    离开陈默住处之后的周牧之走在路上脸色阴沉得可怕，他的胸口还在隐隐作痛每一步都走得格外艰难。

    那个陈默居然敢对他动手。

    一个外门弟子居然敢对他这个内门执剑长老的大弟子动手。

    这时的周牧之也是越想越气脚步也越来越快，他穿过一条走廊之后很快就回到了内门。

    走进内门区域之后周牧之放慢了脚步，他在心里想着今天的事情绝对不能让别人知道。

    要是让别人知道他堂堂内门执剑长老的大弟子被一个外门弟子打伤了，他的脸面往哪搁以后在内门他还怎么见人。

    只见周牧之咬了咬牙加快了脚步。

    可刚走了没多远迎面就走来几个人。

    这几个人都是内门的弟子平时跟在他身边也算是他的跟班吧。

    “周师兄您回来了。”一个弟子笑着迎了上来。

    可当他看到周牧之的脸色之后笑容僵在了脸上，周牧之的脸色苍白额头上还带着汗珠。

    “周师兄您怎么了脸色怎么这么难看。”另一个弟子问道。

    “没事。”周牧之说道。
content_en:
After Zhou Muzhi left, Chen Mo didn't rush back to the house. He sat down cross-legged in the yard and closed his eyes.

    "Chen Mo, why don't you go back to your house and rest?" Zhou Xuan asked standing aside.

    "Practice for a while."

    At this moment, Zhou Xuan looked at him sitting cross-legged on the ground and was filled with worry. He was thinking in his mind why this Chen Mo was not in a hurry at all.

    "Chen Mo, you just beat up Zhou Muzhi. He is a disciple of the elder of the inner sect, the sword-bearing elder. The inner sect will definitely not let it go. What if the elder of the sword-bearing sect blames him?"

    "Just hit me, what else can I do?"

    "But..."

    "It's nothing, but if he comes to trouble me, why should I stand and let him fail?"

    So he thought to himself that Chen Mo was actually right. After all, Zhou Muzhi was the one who came to trouble him first, so he couldn't let Chen Mo stand and get beaten.

    But having said that, Zhou Xuan still felt uneasy. The expression on his face as he was pacing back and forth in the yard was full of anxiety.

    At this time Zhou Xuan stopped and sighed.

    So I thought to myself, forget it, since Chen Mo doesn't have to worry.

    Then he turned around and walked into the house, leaving Chen Mo sitting alone in the yard to practice. When the sun shone on Chen Mo, he could feel that his breathing was very even and steady.

    The true energy in the body slowly circulates, and the cultivation of the fifth level of the golden elixir is more stable than before.

    But Chen Mo knew in his heart that this strength was not enough. Zhou Muzhi's cultivation at the first level of Nascent Soul was a whole realm higher than his current level.

    The ability to defeat Zhou Muzhi today was all due to the sudden attack of Qiankun Mirror. If they were to fight head-on, he was no match for Zhou Muzhi, so he had to improve his strength as soon as possible.

    At this moment, Chen Mo was thinking in his mind and continued to circulate the true energy in his body.

    After leaving Chen Mo's residence, Zhou Muzhi walked on the road with a terrifyingly gloomy face. His chest was still aching, making every step extremely difficult.

    That Chen Mo actually dared to attack him.

    An outer sect disciple actually dared to attack him, the eldest disciple of the inner sect sword-wielding elder.

    At this time, Zhou Muzhi became more and more angry and walked faster and faster. He walked through a corridor and quickly returned to the inner door.

    Zhou Muzhi slowed down after entering the inner door area. He thought in his heart that today's events must not be known to others.

    If others knew that his dignified inner sect sword-wielding elder disciple was injured by an outer sect disciple, how would he be able to see anyone in the inner sect in the future?

    Zhou Muzhi gritted his teeth and quickened his pace.

    But not long after walking, several people came towards me.

    These people are all disciples of the inner sect. They usually follow him and can be regarded as his followers.

    "Senior Brother Zhou, you are back." A disciple greeted him with a smile.

    But when he saw Zhou Muzhi's face, his smile froze. Zhou Muzhi's face was pale and there were beads of sweat on his forehead.

    "Senior Brother Zhou, what's wrong with you? Why do you look so ugly?" Another disciple asked.

    "It's okay." Zhou Muzhi said.
title_en: Chapter 22 What a shame and humiliation
